info.title: GridCast-AU API
info.description: Read-only archive of GridCast-AU's scored outputs for Victoria (VIC1): LightGBM C demand forecasts with CQR prediction intervals, the M1 price baselines, actuals and anomaly events (recipe v2), for issue times 1 Aug 2023 → 30 Sep 2026 (NEM time). Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC; inputs need an explicit offset (`Z`, or `%2B10:00` in a query string). See `/v1/meta` for provenance, scored metrics, disclosures and licences.

get.description:
Database, publications (the latest attempt of each succeeded), anomaly runs, and
what recompute and explain need: the feature context and every model file.
What is served, its provenance and scored metrics, disclosures and licences.

mw.title: Mw

dirty.description: Its files differed from that commit (image: any change to the files it copies, untracked included; checkout: tracked files)

source.title: Source

forecast_float64_mw.title: Forecast Float64 Mw
forecast_float64_mw.description: M2's forecast before the float32 cast: anchor + base value + Σ contributions (within the gate's tolerance)

leads_without_forecast.title: Leads Without Forecast
leads_without_forecast.description: Requested leads with no stored forecast (not explained)

value.title: Value
value.description: The float32 feature value the model saw

index.title: Index
index.description: Position in `fits`; leads refer to it

leads_recomputed.title: Leads Recomputed
leads_recomputed.description: Leads of this issue time it forecast

FitUsed.title: FitUsed
FitUsed.description: One stored LightGBM C fit (M2's retrain record) that forecast this issue time.

Gate.title: Gate
Gate.description: Criterion E1's gate over the explained leads (m4_plan.md §3).

GateFailure.title: GateFailure

actuals.title: Actuals

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the values are stored (forecast_metrics row set)

matches_stored.title: Matches Stored
matches_stored.description: Every lead matches: the same leads are null, the others are equal float32

max_float64_diff_mw.title: Max Float64 Diff Mw
max_float64_diff_mw.description: Largest |M2's float64 forecast − stored float32|, for information

recomputed_mw.title: Recomputed Mw
recomputed_mw.description: M2's code path on the rebuilt feature row, cast to float32 as M2 stored it; null where the row is incomplete (M2 forecast only complete rows)

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: Both null, or equal float32 values

fit.title: Fit
fit.description: Index into `fits`; null where nothing was recomputed
